infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Avant uses your photo library to let you select profile photos that other users will see on your dating profile. For example, you can choose up to 6 photos from your gallery to showcase yourself.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Avant uses the camera to let you take a new photo for your dating profile. For example, you can snap a selfie to use as your main profile picture.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Avant uses your location to automatically detect your city during onboarding. This is optional — you can always type your city manually instead.
